generalHelp.title: KeepTrack Help
generalHelp.overview: No menu or view is open, so this is the general KeepTrack help. Every menu and view has its own help.
generalHelp.howToUse: Open the drawer and pick a tool to open its menu, or switch to a view such as the Flat Map or Polar View. Then press Shift+F1 to see the help for that menu or view. Click an object on the globe to select it and see its details.
generalHelp.tip1: Layers you turn on (for example covariance ellipsoids) have no menu of their own, so Shift+F1 keeps showing this general help while only layers are on.
generalHelp.tip2: Use Close, Escape, or click outside this panel to close it.
